origin.description: List the locale identifiers ICU knows, in stringi sort order.
origin.details: The identifiers are sorted with the English collator at primary strength and with numeric collation on.
origin.value: A character vector of locale names.

translation.description: List the locale identifiers ICU knows, in stringi sort order.
translation.details: Names come from icu.Locale.getAvailableLocales. The order is an en_US collator at primary strength with numeric collation.
translation.value: A list of locale name strings.
